# MIT OpenCourseWare

> > MIT OpenCourseWare provides free access to course materials from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, covering engineering, computer science, ethics, and more.

MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) is MIT's initiative to publish educational materials from thousands of courses, making world-class MIT education freely available to learners worldwide. The platform includes lecture notes, problem sets, exams, code samples, and external resources across disciplines including civil and environmental engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence ethics, and project management.

## Key Topics

- Civil and Environmental Engineering
- Engineering Problem Solving
- Computer Science and Programming
- AI Ethics and Autonomous Weapons
- Project Evaluation and Management
- Construction Management
- Civil Engineering Design
- Financial Economics
- International Law and Engineering Ethics
- Uncertainty in Engineering
- Public-Private Partnerships
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Recursion and Algorithms
- Environmental Engineering

## Computer Science and Engineering Problem Solving

- [Classes II - Object-Oriented Programming](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/mit1_00s12_lec_8): Object-oriented programming lecture on Classes II by Kocur & Cassa
- [Recursion Lecture Notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/mit1_00s12_lec_12): Recursion lecture notes by Kocur & Cassa for programming course
- [Lecture 29 Code Files](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/lecture_29_code): Lecture 29 code files for Computers & Engineering Problem Solving
- [Lecture 31 Code Files](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/lecture_31_code): Lecture 31 code files for engineering problem solving course
- [Quiz 1](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/mit1_00s12_quiz1_s11): Quiz 1 for Computers & Engineering Problem Solving by Gonzalez team
- [Final Exam](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-00-introduction-to-computers-and-engineering-problem-solving-spring-2012/resources/mit1_00s12_final_s10): Final exam for Kocur & Cassa's engineering problem solving course

## AI Ethics and Engineering Ethics

- [Killer Robots Ban Blocked by US and Russia](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/10-01-ethics-for-engineers-artificial-intelligence-spring-2020/external-resources/killer-robots-ban-blocked-by-us-and-russia-at-un-meeting_ac85ca98-63f8-4ceb-9900-aa6a2426403e): External resource on autonomous weapons ban blocked by US & Russia at UN
- [Hague Convention VIII on Submarine Mines](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/10-01-ethics-for-engineers-artificial-intelligence-spring-2020/external-resources/hague-convention-viii-relative-to-the-laying-of-automatic-submarine-contact-mines_06673815-ff26-47f5-ac85-85515776dcc0): Hague Convention VIII on submarine mines for AI ethics course
- [Facing Up to Facebook](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/10-01-ethics-for-engineers-artificial-intelligence-spring-2020/external-resources/facing-up-to-facebook_46825fc8-2da0-46b7-b05c-a961643629fc): Facebook ethics external resource for Trout's AI ethics course
- [First Amendment Reference](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/10-01-ethics-for-engineers-artificial-intelligence-spring-2020/external-resources/first-amendment_68b9b71f-447d-4565-a79a-01b780f6fc5a): First Amendment reference for Trout's AI ethics engineering course

## Project Evaluation and Management

- [Project Management Chapter](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-011-project-evaluation-spring-2011/resources/mit1_011s11_chpt14b): Project management chapter by Sussman & Martland for Project Evaluation
- [Public-Private Partnerships](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-011-project-evaluation-spring-2011/resources/mit1_011s11_chpt12): Public-private partnerships chapter for Project Evaluation course
- [Tsunami-Related Reading](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-011-project-evaluation-spring-2011/resources/mit1_011s11_read16a): Tsunami-related reading for Project Evaluation course materials
